name: agent-slots help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:agent-slots. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Name matches (regex)
entries.text: Where you set “Name matches (regex)”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Agent cap.

entries.title: Agent cap
entries.text: Shows the “Agent cap” part of this screen. Part of Agent cap.

entries.title: VPS build limits
entries.text: What the VPS itself enforces for headless builds. Builds at once is how many may run together: the VPS counts live claude -p sessions itself and refuses the next launch past the limit, whoever asks (dispatcher, axHub, swarm, a hand launch). All builds share one CPU and memory budget (the axf-builds.slice), and docker test runs get their own CPU and memory cap. Only Brett changes these, from his own signed-in console.

entries.title: Builds at once
entries.text: How many builds (headless sessions and swarm jobs) run together (default 8). One setting: the VPS refuses the next one past it and the queue holds it until a place frees. Only Brett changes it.
